composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Create a compact cuttlefish with broad side fins. Keep the arms short and grouped beneath the face, with no tangled spread. The side fins form two clear curved wings around the central body. Use subtle spotted texture and one calm visible eye, avoiding a glossy or eerie appearance. A pale blue-gray background and soft diffuse light isolate the silhouette. Use stylized marine portrait illustration. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
